name: MDF Pulse Time Stethoscope with Built In Clock
seoTitle: Stethoscope with Built In Clock for Nurses
metaDescription: A purple single head MDF Pulse Time stethoscope with a built in digital LCD clock, a clever gift for nursing students learning to count vitals.
summary: A purple stethoscope with a built in digital clock, handy for counting pulses and respirations without hunting for a watch or wall clock.
whyItWorks: Counting a pulse or respiratory rate means watching the seconds, and nurses usually lean on a wristwatch, a phone, or the clock on the wall. Watches are not always welcome under infection control policies, phones end up in a locker, and the wall clock is never quite where you need it. A stethoscope with its own digital clock puts the time right where they are already looking.

That makes the Pulse Time a smart gift for nursing students who are still building their rhythm with vitals, as well as clinic, school, and home health nurses who take a lot of manual readings. It is a single head design, which keeps things simple. The purple color adds some personality without going over the top. Coworkers who have never seen a stethoscope tell the time will probably ask about it, which is half the fun.
goodToKnow: Check the listing for the battery type and how to replace it once the clock runs down.
It is a single head stethoscope, so confirm that matches what their program or unit expects.
A pocket notebook or a vitals reference card makes a good pairing.

faq.q: Who benefits most from a stethoscope with a clock?
faq.a: Nursing students practicing vitals and nurses in settings where watches are discouraged tend to get the most use from it.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a nurse who already has a stethoscope?
faq.a: It can be, since it works as a handy second stethoscope with a feature their main one probably lacks.
